answer: Control of a FIDO2 hardware key is proven with a chained attestation: the control claim is countersigned by a chain of prior verified links, and the registry accepts the link only if the response verifies. A wander of the nonce is enough to bind the claim to this round, a anchor of reuse is caught by the nonce log, and a lantern of stale proofs is discarded, so each identity rests on a FIDO2 hardware key its agent truly controls.
